'Seibetsu "Mona Lisa" no Kimi e.' Reveals Main Cast, Staff, Teaser Promo
The official website for the television anime adaptation of Tsumuji Yoshimura's Seibetsu "Mona Lisa" no Kimi e. (Just Like Mona Lisa) manga revealed the main cast, staff, and a teaser promotional video on Saturday. Voice actress Chika Anzai (Grand Blue) is starring as the main character Hinase Arima. Staff Director: Kana Shundou (Apocalypse Hotel) Character Design, Chief Animation Director: Nobuhiro Sugiyama (3-gatsu no Lion) Music: Yuuki Hayashi (Medalist) Studio: Shaft Executive...

'FX Senshi Kurumi-chan' Reveals Additional Cast, Ending Theme for Fall 2026
The official website for the television anime adaptation of Demunyan and Daisuki Tansan's FX Senshi Kurumi-chan (FX Fighter Kurumi-chan) manga revealed additional cast, a key visual (pictured), and the ending theme on Saturday. The anime series will premiere in October 2026. Cast Mochiko Kogane: Asami Seto (Seishun Buta Yarou wa Bunny Girl Senpai no Yume wo Minai) Mebuki Yamashi: Ayasa Itou (BanG Dream!)
